description: Punti di fornitura di Teleriscaldamento per POD is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Comune di Milano. Il dataset espone i punti di fornitura di Teleriscaldamento nel Comune di Milano con contratto attivo alla data del 24 dicembre 2020; i punti sono contrassegnati dai rispettivi POD. Coverage: Comune di Milano. The portal files it under the publisher Comune di Milano. Its tags are geo, georeferenziatocsv, indirizzo, municipio, nil. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, JSON. The portal shows 2026-09-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support heat network planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
